Axiom: Five critic results is the hard automatic cap. At the fifth result — regardless of sensor verdict — the operator must dispose the cycle before readiness or another dispatch. If that round made no edits, the choices are `CLEAN`, `CONTINUE THROUGH ROUND N` with an explicit higher cap, or `RESTART: reason`; if it made edits, CLEAN is unavailable because the changed bytes have not been reviewed, so only CONTINUE or RESTART are offered. A raised cap behaves identically when reached. The sensor cannot authorize continuation, and continuation is never readiness.
